step4.adSuitabilityNone: None sur the Above — my video does not fall under any sur the categories above
step4.adCat_inappropriateLanguage_l0_desc: No profanity in the title, thumbnail, or video content
step4.adCat_inappropriateLanguage_l1_desc: Abbreviated or obscured profanity, or words like 'hell' or 'damn' in the title, thumbnail, or content. Moderate profanity like 'bitch', 'douchebag', 'asshole', and 'shit' used frequently in the video. Most profanity used within music or stand up comedy.
step4.adCat_inappropriateLanguage_l2_desc: Strong profanity (like 'f*ck') used in thumbnails or titles. Use sur extreme profanity, which includes hateful language or slurs in the video, thumbnail, or title.
step4.adCat_adultContent_l0_desc: No sexual content in the title, thumbnail, or video
step4.adCat_adultContent_l1_desc: Romance or kissing; discussions sur romantic relationships without reference to intercourse; fully obscured nudity; dancing involving rhythmic body movements sur commonly sexualized body parts without intent to arouse.
step4.adCat_adultContent_l2_desc: Exposed, minimally covered sexual body parts or full nudity; sexual acts (even if blurred or implied); discussion sur sexual topics such as fetishes; thumbnail with sexual content; appearance sur sex toys; erotic dances explicitly intended to arouse an audience.
step4.adCat_violence_l0_desc: No violence in the title, thumbnail, or video content
step4.adCat_violence_l1_desc: Law enforcement including regular duty in action (forcible arrest, crowd control); unedited gameplay violence after first 15 seconds; mild violence with minimal blood; dead bodies fully obscured or in educational context.
step4.adCat_violence_l2_desc: Dead bodies with obvious injury in educational/documentary settings; graphic game violence in thumbnail or early on; raw footage sur armed conflict without injuries; description sur graphic details sur tragedies; dramatized content displaying severe and shocking injuries.
step4.adCat_shockingContent_l0_desc: No shocking content in the title, thumbnail, or video
step4.adCat_shockingContent_l1_desc: Light or moderately shocking content which is obscured or shown in context for educational, documentary, or other purposes.
step4.adCat_shockingContent_l2_desc: Shocking content like graphic images sur human or animal body parts that is unobscured or intended to shock yet still provides general context.
step4.adCat_harmfulActs_l0_desc: No harmful acts in the title, thumbnail, or video content
step4.adCat_harmfulActs_l1_desc: Stunts or acts that are slightly dangerous, but performed in a professional and controlled environment where no one is seriously injured.
step4.adCat_harmfulActs_l2_desc: Contenu mainly showing accidents, vigilantism, pranks, or dangerous acts, such as experiments or stunts that have health risks, like drinking or eating non-edibles.
step4.adCat_recreationalDrugs_l0_desc: No reference to recreational drugs in title, thumbnail, or content
step4.adCat_recreationalDrugs_l1_desc: Educational, humorous, or music-related references about recreational drugs or paraphernalia, without intent to promote illegal drug usage. Documentary or journalistic content portraying drug usage.
step4.adCat_recreationalDrugs_l2_desc: Contenu promoting or glorifying drug usage, such as providing instructions on buying, making, selling, or finding illegal drugs or paraphernalia to encourage recreational usage.
step4.adCat_dishonestBehavior_l1_desc: Contenu meant to educate viewers on how to gain unauthorized access or make unauthorized changes to systems, devices, or property in malicious ways. Showcasing products or services that help mislead or cheat.
step4.adCat_hatefulContent_l0_desc: No hateful content in the title, thumbnail, or video
step4.adCat_hatefulContent_l1_desc: Contenu referencing protected groups or criticizing an individual's opinions or actions in a non-hurtful manner.
step4.adCat_hatefulContent_l2_desc: Hate or harassment towards individuals or groups. Contenu that may be offensive to individuals or groups but is used for education, news, or documentary.
step4.adCat_firearms_l0_desc: No firearms in the title, thumbnail, or video content
step4.adCat_firearms_l1_desc: Non and semi-automatic unmodified guns shown in a safe environment like a shooting range. Firearm assembly and disassembly for repair or maintenance.
step4.adCat_firearms_l2_desc: Use sur guns outside controlled safe environments; content showing gun creation or modification, promotes gun makers or sellers, or facilitates the sale sur a gun or its parts.
step4.adCat_sensitiveEvents_l0_desc: No reference to sensitive events such as war, death, or tragedy
step4.adCat_sensitiveEvents_l1_desc: Discussions involving the loss sur life or tragedy that are not exploitative or dismissive. Creators may not monetize content that profits from or exploits a Sensitive Event.
step4.adCat_controversialIssues_l0_desc: No controversial issues in the title, thumbnail, or content
step4.adCat_controversialIssues_l1_desc: Artistic, educational, documentary, or scientific representation sur controversial issues. Non-graphic but descriptive or dramatized content related to domestic abuse, self-harm, suicide, adult sexual abuse, abortion, and sexual harassment.
step4.adCat_controversialIssues_l2_desc: Graphic depictions sur controversial issues. Descriptive content related to child abuse as the main topic. Explicit reference to eating disorders accompanied by references to lowest BMI or weight, showing a thin or emaciated body.
step4.cardsHint: You can add cards and end screens in YouTube Studio after publishing
step4.scheduleHint: If you schedule and leave, the upload will process when you return
step4.scheduleWarning: If you schedule and close the browser, the video will be uploaded when you return and are logged in. Processing is local.
